sens_en: to wipe, to rub, to brush past
origine_fr: Pour s'en souvenir : à gauche 扌, la main. À droite 察, examiner, qui se lit chá, proche de cā sans en donner le son. La main qui frotte en regardant de près : essuyer, frotter.
origine_en: As a memory aid: on the left is 扌, the hand. On the right is 察, to examine, read chá, close to cā without giving its sound. The hand that rubs while looking closely: to wipe, to rub.
